text: 港交所文件显示，中国石化(SNP.N)于7月20日在其他交易所回购了65万股A股，金额为340万人民币；同日还回购了300万股H股，金额为1290万港元。
text_en: HKEx filing shows Sinopec (SNP.N) repurchased 650,000 A-shares on other exchanges on July 20 for 3.4 million yuan, and also repurchased 3 million H-shares for 12.9 million Hong Kong dollars on the same day.
